The '''''Discord''''' was a [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] that served in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the conflict, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] ship ''[[Leveler]]'' mistakenly identified the Confederate [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] [[Reaper (destroyer)|''Reaper'']] as being the ''Discord'', while in the [[Fath system]], due to flawed data that was supplied to him by [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]].
